title: Portland Slag Cement - Specification (Fifth Revision)
clause_1_scope: 1.1 This standard covers the manufacture and chemical and physical requirements for Portland slag cement.

chemical_properties: chloride conicnt in cement shall not exceed 0. 1 percent
chloride content shall not exceed 005 percent
insoluble residue content from 2*5 to 4 percent
marking_requirements: Each product/package must bear the manufacturer's name, trademark, and grade.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS ISI Mark) subject to licensing.
